front.title: YANG Data Model and C-SMA Query Envelopes for Computing-Aware Traffic Steering (CATS) Service Context-Staging Metrics

abstract.t: This document specifies a Standards Track YANG 1.1 data model (ietf- cats-context-staging-metrics) and an on-demand deterministic CBOR query envelope for Computing-Aware Traffic Steering (CATS) service context-staging latency metrics. The specification defines three explicit observation-endpoint boundaries (transport-submit, remote- placement, and consumer-usable), enforces four-tuple snapshot view consistency (producer-id, boot-id, view-id, snapshot-id) with clock- uncertainty bounds, prohibits direct arithmetic addition of marginal latency quantiles across stages, and provides a point-to-point C-SMA to C-PS residency lookup envelope that avoids underlay routing protocol flooding.
